data.name: Sharvilaksha
data.gender_notes: Sharvilaksha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharva is a name of Lord Shiva and Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Sharvilaksha signifies the grace of Goddess Lakshmi upon one who is dedicated to Lord Shiva. The name Sharvilaksha carries the meaning “Goddess Lakshmi's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvilaksha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess lakshmi's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that invokes the blessings of Lord Shiva and Goddess Lakshmi.
data.etymology: Sharvilaksha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Lakshmi's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvilaksha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Sharvilaksha carries deep spiritual significance, representing the seeking of divine blessings from Lord Shiva for material prosperity and inner peace, enriched by the grace of Goddess Lakshmi. It is a reminder of the importance of marriage of spiritual and material prosperity for a fulfilling and contented life.
